title: Two Shores
blurb: 2017 to 2026. The US and China as dated beliefs on two equally lit shores: a plan, a fence of rules, a price tag, a struck match, and a dialogue with two names.

shots.setting: Two skylines facing each other across dark water at dawn; a wooden jetty runs out from the middle with a Go board on it · July 2017

lines.text: In 2017, China aimed to be “the world's primary AI innovation center” by 2030.
lines.spoken: In twenty seventeen, China aimed to be “the world's primary A.I. innovation center” by twenty thirty.
lines.direction: measured, neutral, a teacher reading a document aloud

shots.visual: THIS SHOT: through the study window, two equal shores at dawn; the 2017 plan's parchment page rises over the right shore, its 2030 ring glowing, naming no rival; one stone is set on the jetty's Go board. CHAPTER INDEX TAB (the film's chapter-card device for clue chapters): at the shot's first frame a manila index tab, typed in Special Elite with the chapter title 'Two Shores', drops down from the frame's top edge at TOP-left like a file-divider tab, holds for 2.5 seconds over the picture, and slides back up (top-left, so it never shares the bottom-left corner with the date stamp); no new shot, no lamp change. CAMERA: through the study WINDOW (the WINDOW RULE below); the shelf appears only as a reflection in the glass. The lead-in here is short, so the tab rides over the first line, as ch02-s01's does. WINDOW RULE (canonical for this chapter; repeated word for word in every ch14 shot): the strait is always seen THROUGH the study window. The window's frame and mullions sit at the edges of the frame as a faint L1 occluder (ink silhouettes with candleAmber rim hairlines only, never crossing the centre of the image), so every ch14 picture reads as looking out from the study. Wherever the candles, a match or the narrator's hands appear, they are a reflection on ONE plane only, L2, at about 35% alpha with a slight water ripple, so the hands read as a reflection in the glass, never as giants over the water. KIT DEPENDENCY (blocking for film-shots, see staging.kitWork): finish/reflection(layerFn, {alpha, flip:false, ripple}), an offscreen sub-render of the study shelf composited over the water. Staging rule for the whole chapter: two skylines of equal height, equal mass and identical warmth face each other across a band of dark water, left and right, mirror-balanced in the frame. They are generic paper-cut cities (towers, bridges, a few hills), with no landmarks, flags, emblems, dragons, eagles or red tint, and their small lit windows flicker on the same rhythm. Whatever the mood, both shores always take exactly the same palette. Haze lies on the water. From the centre of the near bank a long wooden jetty runs out into the water, and on its end sits a Go board on a low stand, lit by a lantern hung on a post, with a stone bowl on each side. There is no candle shelf on the jetty: CANDLE PLACEMENT (canonical for this chapter; repeated in every candle shot): the China-race candles are NOT on the jetty. They stand at the right end of the study's own candle shelf, the same shelf ch15-s08 pulls back across, and are seen only as a reflection in the study window glass that ch13-s06 opened onto the strait: the reflected shelf, its flames and the narrator's steady hands float over the water. The reflection keeps the study's candleAmber (STUDY LOCK: the study's colour enters this chapter only as that reflection), while the strait and shores beyond keep the shot's own mood. Open on the study window frame itself: dark mullions against the dawn beyond, the unlit room behind the camera. Push through it, FLAME PUSH-style but with no lamp change and no mood crossfade (a short camera push to lens 1.6 through the gap between two mullions, which slide out to the frame edges and stay there as the faint L1 occluder), arriving wide and still on the two shores at dawn; then a slow push in toward the jetty. On the first line a single parchment page rises from the right shore and hangs in the air above it: the plan, stamped with the date, its three steps marked 2020 · 2025 · 2030 as three small rings, the last one glowing. On 'no rival' the camera eases back to show the whole page: there is no name on it but its own, and the left shore simply goes on glowing. A hand from the right side sets one stone on the Go board; nothing answers yet. CANDLE-CLOCK RULE (canonical; repeated word for word in every candle shot): every belief candle is cut to the same lit height, 45 scored rings at a pitch of 6 px per ring at L3 (270 px), its flame on the top ring and a small tag at its base giving the year it was lit. It burns down one ring per year the belief is held. The wax that burns away is never lost: it stays above the stub as a ghost paper sleeve, ring-scored and translucent in the haze, so sleeve plus stub is always the full lit height and the SLEEVE's length is the years (16 rings = 96 px; 39 rings = 234 px). The sleeves are the bars of the chart: a longer sleeve means a belief held longer. A candle still lit has a live flame where sleeve meets stub; one put out keeps its sleeve, dark, with a thread of smoke; one that guttered has a frayed rim.

shots.setting: The water between the shores: a fence of rule pages rising from it; identical lecterns on each bank; the study's candle shelf reflected in the window glass over the water · 7-8 October 2022

lines.text: October 2022. Citing military uses, Washington fenced off high-end chips, and the tools to make them. Beijing replied that America “abuses export control measures.”
lines.spoken: October, twenty twenty-two. Citing military uses, Washington fenced off high-end chips, and the tools to make them. Beijing replied that America “abuses export control measures.”
lines.direction: even and exact; two sentences, two equal shores: the same weight and the same pace for each capital; Beijing's quoted words read plainly, not dramatised

lines.text: Two new candles: computing power is the chokepoint, and China is a year or two behind. A new question for the file: can a fence around chips hold?

shots.setting: Before a vast dark data hall on the right bank; a small paper price tag on a string at its door · 26 December 2024

lines.text: December 2024: a Chinese lab, DeepSeek, priced its model's final training run at about five and a half million dollars.
lines.spoken: December twenty twenty-four: a Chinese lab, DeepSeek, priced its model's final training run at about five and a half million dollars.
lines.direction: plain; introduce the lab simply, as a newcomer; 'priced' and 'final training run' clear, so the scope is carried by the sentence itself; a small lift of interest on the price

lines.text: That counted rented hours for the last run only: not the research before it, nor the hardware it owned.
lines.direction: precise and patient, like a footnote; a small pause at the colon; 'not the research before it, nor the hardware it owned' even, a matter of scope, no insinuation

shots.setting: Left bank, a shuttered window; the right bank, a far lit room of officials and a lantern set on the water; then the left bank's market strip, all seen through the study window · September 2024 to 27 January 2025

lines.text: Machines had just learned to think longer: trained by reward, they wrote long working notes before answering. OpenAI hid those notes by design.
lines.spoken: Machines had just learned to think longer: trained by reward, they wrote long working notes before answering. Open A.I. hid those notes by design.
lines.direction: plain and clear on the mechanism, a new idea said simply ('trained by reward' a quiet echo of AlphaGo's wins; 'working notes' clear); 'OpenAI hid those notes by design' level, a fact not a charge, the same weight the next line gives DeepSeek

lines.text: Then DeepSeek released such a model, its method and weights open to all.
lines.direction: even-handed, the same weight as the line before; 'open to all' with quiet weight: anyone could download it
level, a reporter's tone; no relish at the loss; the torn ticker and its label carry the record

Left bank, September 2024: high in one tower, a tall shuttered window. Through the slats, in silhouette only, a long roll of scratch paper spools fast from one roller to another, lines of working rippling past like shadow-writing (thinking longer). Its label sets in beneath the window on 'longer' and is read under the rest of the line. On 'reward' a single crisp typed line (the answer) slides out under the sill into the light, and a small brass check-stamp drops onto it (trained by reward). On 'hid' the slats close tight: only the answer line shows, the scroll's shadow still moving behind them. No lab logo; the window is drawn exactly like the right bank's windows, the same warmth. On 'Then' the camera pans across the water to the right bank, 20 January 2025 (the o1 label leaves frame with the pan): far off, a single lit window in a formal hall: a long table of officials in silhouette, with one generic figure among them (Liang, never a likeness, small and distant). In the same frame, at the water's edge below, on 'method' a paper lantern lettered R1 · OPEN WEIGHTS is released onto the water: its paper is translucent, the same kind of scratch scroll visible inside it in plain view (the open rhyme of the shuttered window), and a small recipe card is tied to its handle. It floats out, and on 'all' it drifts past the jetty's end: in the same frame, with no cutaway, a hand from the RIGHT shore sets a second stone on the Go board as the lantern passes (the board now holds two right-shore stones and one left-shore answer). Both happen under the same date stamp. Cut across the water to the left bank, 27 January: on 'week' a tall paper ticker-strip hanging from a tower like a banner begins to tear, and on 'fell' it drops in one long fall while a chip silhouette on the bank dims. The strait and both shores keep this shot's cold winterBlue haze, exactly as in ch14-s03 (no red anywhere in the strait, the sky or on either shore). The market drop is carried by the falling ticker banner and its label, not by colour. Hold on the torn end of the strip swinging over the dark bank. No candles and no hands in this shot: the struck match belongs to ch14-s04b. TEXT RULE: besides stamps and name cards, at most two text items (the o1 label, gone before the pan ends, and the Nvidia label); R1's cost figures go to the credits sources.
